I helped my parents move halfway across the country. As a "thank you" for helping they bought me a first class plane ticket home. My flight was scheduled to leave at about 9am. As everyone is sitting in the airport waiting for the plane to arrive, the airline announces that the plane had a mechanical issue shortly after it left the ground. It was determined that the failure wasn't enough to require the plane to land immediately. Therefore, the plane was going to finish its flight and the mechanics where going to fix the problem when it arrived at the airport I was at. Our flight was going to be delayed 10-20 minutes tops. Okay, no big deal.

The plane arrives, the passengers disembark, the mechanics start checking things out. It takes the mechanics about 30 minutes to figure out what the problem was. As it turns out, one of the two air conditioners broke. The plane only needs one and the other is a backup unit. The mechanics do not possess the parts to fix the air conditioner onsite. They call the main hub and report the situation. The mechanics feel that the plane can proceed with our flight and have the parts flown to our destination where the mechanics there can fix it.

Around 10:30am, we finally receive word that the main hub is "okay" with the mechanic's plan, but they want to see some pictures of the problem first. The mechanics take out their cellphone and take pictures of the problem area. 11:30am the airline announces that we are still waiting for the main hub to officially sign off on the plan and then we can start boarding. Obviously, by this time, people are getting hungry and some have missed connecting flights. All-in-all not a happy group.

I might mention that the airline has to this point, offered nothing to appease the passengers sitting in the terminal. The lady next to me asks me to watch her luggage while she goes and grabs something to eat. She is gone for a bit then comes back. It is now 12:30pm, I am starting to get hungry. I ask the lady next to me to watch my luggage. I grab some food and come back to learn that now the airline is offering food vouchers. Hmm, great, something I have no need for now.

1:00pm we get an announcement that the main hub is waiting for the pictures from the mechanics to be faxed to them so they can assess the mechanic's plan. Yes, you read that correctly...faxed. I don't know why on earth pictures would need to be faxed in this day and age, nor do I know what happened to those pictures.

At 2:30pm the boarding time for my flight switches to 6:30pm. Then we get the announcement that the main hub has decided it does not want to fly the plane with only one air conditioner. It is therefore sending 2 mechanics and parts from the main hub to this airport. They should arrive in about 2-2.5 hours. Then we have to wait for them to fix the plane or we can try to arrange another flight.

I get on the telephone and talk to the airline rep. There are no more direct flights that day. I can wait until tomorrow or I can take a flight to a different city and then switch planes to get to my city. Alright, fine, I take the two flights. My original flight was scheduled to have a meal in first class. However, it turns out, neither of my two flights includes a meal. I finally arrive at my destination around 11pm having not eaten since 12:30pm.

Afterward my parents complained to the airline. Their compensation was a $50 voucher for a future flight, good for one year. All in all I spent the better part of 18 hours in the airport or on the plane for what should have been a 3 hour flight.
